planner_finish.summary:
Single-episode success on libero_goal task 8 seed 0 ("put the bowl on the plate"), terminated=true at step 13 with zero resets.

Localization (perception-isolated): agentview_high + back_project identified the ornate black/white bowl at (-0.128,-0.010) as the unique grasp target and the red-ringed white ceramic disc at (0.058,-0.004,z0.908) as the PLATE, explicitly rejecting the look-alike gray stove burner coil at +y. Wrist was used only for local geometry, never for semantic re-identification.

Execution: pi0_pick("pick up the bowl") lifted the bowl (opening 0.0139); the held-bowl offset was measured per pick by back-projecting the bowl centre (eef+(+0.012,-0.042)). The first carry (6 cm lift, step_clip 0.015) lost the bowl to the flared-rim wedge pinch, and it dropped upright back on the table — recovered in-episode without a reset. Re-localized, re-hovered (compensating the ~0.012 settle undershoot), re-picked (lift 0.089, opening 0.0152, new offset (+0.002,-0.041)), then carried at LOW height (bowl bottom 2-4 cm off the table) in <=4.6 cm hops with gripper:+1 held and step_clip 0.006, re-measuring the held offset after each hop. Final bowl centre (0.065,-0.005) vs plate (0.058,-0.004) = 7 mm residual; a 0.004 m-clipped seating descent fired the On() predicate mid-descent.

Audit and recipe written to goal_t8_s0.json / goal_t8_s0_recipe.jsonl.
